title: SIMAI Framework component set compatibility index
description: The one compatibility index of every component set (standard simai.component-set, one-compatibility-index): one row per set release, with the npm version, the SIMAI Framework it was built over and the lowest core.runtime it needs, the sets it requires and the digest of its receipt. The Loader reads it to place a set a page names without a base: the newest release of the set whose core_runtime this Core meets, served from @simai-studio/<set>@<version>/dist/smart. Published as index.json of the npm package @simai-studio/sets (the Loader reads https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@simai-studio/sets@1/index.json unless SF_BOOT_CONFIG.setIndex says otherwise); written only by the set release route (ui-builder scripts/set-index.py), never by hand. A row is never changed or removed: a fix is a new release and a new row.

sets.description: Every set with at least one release: what a consumer needs to list it without reading its passport.

releases.description: One row per release, in the order they were published.

release.description: <set>-<first 12 hex of source_revision>, the tag on the set's repository.

core_runtime.description: The lowest core.runtime the release needs; every SIMAI Framework pair at or above it runs it.

pair.description: The free release the set was built and tested over.
